name: PT Ekamas Mora Republik Tbk
summary: PT Ekamas Mora Republik Tbk engages in the fiber optic infrastructure for telecommunication network. It serves various customer segmentation such as telecommunications, ISP/wholesales, government, enterprise, education, oil and gas, media and hospitality, and retail industries. Its services include connectivity, Internet services, data center, and value-added services. It operates through the following segments: Telco, Wholesale, Retail, and Other. The company was founded on August 8, 2000 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
